edible?

ご安心ください、害はありません。
味の方も好評でした。<EN>Please rest assured, it's harmless. The
taste has been well-received.

食糧が残っているのか。
驚きだ。<EN>There's still food left? Astonishing.

特殊な方法で生産しているのです。
ただ、一度に多くはご用意できず……<EN>It's produced through a special method.
However, we can't prepare much at
once...

the people couldn't survive...

people with just this place.
